title: Case Study: How Mercor Uses Sixtyfour to Find AI Training Experts
summary: How Sixtyfour helps Mercor find rare experts who can generate training problems current AI models cannot solve.
body_markdown:
Mercor finds rare domain experts who can create questions and problems current state of the art models cannot solve.


GPT-4 and similar models are already strong enough that most people cannot consistently generate failure cases. Labs need experts whose knowledge exceeds what the model learned from the internet's corpus.


Sixtyfour starts with targeted data sources, then uses recursive enrichment agents to explore publications, co-authors, conference presentations, forums, directories, and professional signals until it builds a complete expertise profile.


Mercor can create qualified candidate lists in hours rather than weeks, and the candidates are better matched to the rare expertise required for AI training.


Model improvement depends on failure cases where the current model is wrong and a human expert is right. Those examples become training data for the next generation of models.
